text:
kai: Hi all, I'm Kai (kai@freelance-node.io) starting today. Okta invite arrived but my Google alias (kai@redwood.dev) didn't attach so no Drive/Gmail. 1Password shows "no seat" and trying to enroll a passkey on my Pixel gives "device not supported". SMS MFA codes never arrive (roaming). Can someone help with temporary Drive + 1P access and an MFA fallback so I can start the checklist?

it-zara: Welcome Kai! DM a personal email for a temp Drive share. We can send a 48h 1Password guest link and enable TOTP in Okta while SMS is flaky. Passkey errors often come from email alias mismatch  infra will check SCIM rules.

provision-bot: INC-4012 created by it-zara: "Contractor alias + passkey fail + 1P seat" P2.

devex-miguel: Sent a 48h 1Password guest vault link via DM. Shared the onboarding Drive to the personal email when you DM it. Quick note: don't store long-term secrets in guest vaults.

it-zara: Added you to contractors-temp group for basic access. Infra is checking domain mapping of freelance-node.io -> redwood.dev; ETA 4-6h. DM your GitHub handle + public SSH key for repo access and we'll invite you to the contractors team.

peopleops-anu: Welcome Kai! People Ops sent the contractor packet to your personal email. Ping me for payroll/expense questions. :wave:

kai: Thanks everyone  DM'd personal email and SSH key. Guest 1P + Drive access work. I'll use TOTP for now and report back if anything else pops up. Appreciate the quick help! :thumbsup:
